violations.text: There was no evidence that employees are required to report to the person in charge information about their health (illnesses, symptoms) as they relate to diseases that are transmissible through food. State examples were provided during time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 08/31/2026

Proper cooling methods were not used for time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods. Cooked noodles were observed at 80 degrees Fahrenheit in plastic bus bins in walk-in cooler. Noodles were placed into multiple containers to continue cooling process. Cooling methods reviewed and guidance documents provided. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 08/31/2026

ROP tuna and crabsticks were observed thawing with packaging intact in 2 door lowboy. If your refrigerator cannot maintain below 38°F, you must remove the seafood products from the ROP before refrigeration. If thawing by submerging under cold running water, you must either (1) remove the seafood product from the packaging before thawing, or (2) keep it in the packaging during thawing but remove it immediately once thawed. Methods reviewed and guidance document provided. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 08/31/2026

The non-food contact surfaces of the interior of sink basins have an accumulation of grease, food residue, and other debris. Sinks were cleaned during time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 08/31/2026

The doors to the outside, located in the front, are not tight-fitting. Outer openings of a food establishment must be protected against the entry of insects and rodents by tight-fitting doors. New Violation. Correct By: 07/24/2026
